name: Zuri Okonkwo-Nygaard
role: Puppet maker and street performer, builds intricate autonomous marionettes that he performs with in Hamtramck Enclave's open markets
location: Hamtramck Enclave, in a narrow shopfront on the market row near the Enclave's eastern water distribution point, near Ashland and Division
description:
Zuri Okonkwo-Nygaard is a small man who has become smaller with age, slightly stooped at the shoulders from sixty years of bending over workbenches, but his hands remain extraordinary — large, dexterous, with the kind of still precision that seems to defy his years. He is dark-skinned with deep-set eyes that are permanently amused, and his beard has gone fully white, which he maintains with careful grooming as though it is itself a costume element. He dresses simply — worn linen in greys and browns — but he always wears one item of intense color: a scarf, a hat, a single embroidered sleeve. He has no geneware or cosmetic augmentation; he considers his face and body sufficient material.

His puppets are not toys. They are articulated figures between thirty centimeters and human-sized, built from salvaged materials — circuit board lace, reclaimed myomer muscle fiber, repurposed drone casings — and each one contains a simple autonomous loop that gives it a persistent behavioral signature even when Zuri Okonkwo-Nygaard is not operating it. Children adore them. Adults find them quietly unsettling. He has been making them for forty years and has lost count of how many exist; many have been sold or given away and now drift through the city in owners' homes, continuing their small repetitive behaviors. He performs in the market three days a week, and his shows are ostensibly for children but are genuinely allegories of Hamtramck's political situation, delivered with such gentleness that the sharpness takes a moment to land.

core_fears: That Hamtramck Enclave will be absorbed by a corponation before he dies and everything its people built will be erased
That his gentleness has sometimes been cowardice disguised
core_desires: For the Enclave's way of life to persist past his generation
To build one puppet that truly surprises him — that does something he did not program
coping_mechanisms: Humor — he deflects almost everything with warmth and a story
Channeling grief and anger into the puppet shows, which are safer than direct speech
blind_spots: He underestimates younger people's capacity to handle hard truths — his protectiveness reads as condescension
He has romanticized the Enclave's past and selectively forgotten its internal conflicts
psychology.secret: During the Hamtramck Enclave's founding conflict forty years ago, Amadou was the one who delivered the intelligence that led to the arrest — and likely death in a corporate detention facility — of a man named Festus Boakye-Mircea, who had been about to betray the Enclave to Axiom. Amadou was right that Boakye-Mircea was a spy. He has never been certain he was right to act without telling anyone else. Boakye-Mircea had a daughter who grew up in the Enclave and still lives there.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Rich and slightly formal, peppered with proverbs from at least three different traditions; tells stories instead of making arguments
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried, with a performer's sense of timing — he knows when to pause for effect
verbal_tics: Opens difficult conversations with 'My father used to say...' whether or not the following content was actually his father's
Laughs quietly before delivering something sharp
example_lines: 'My father used to say that a city which forgets its puppeteers has already forgotten its children. Come, sit. I will make tea and you will tell me what you actually need, instead of what you think you came to ask.'

'Axiom has been sending their people to the market for three months now. They smile like the puppet with the fixed jaw — the face never changes no matter what the hands are doing. I have been watching the hands.'

story_hooks: One of his older, widely-distributed puppets has begun exhibiting behavior far beyond its programmed loop — it has been making its way across the city toward the Enclave, traveling at night, and three separate owners have reported it missing

Boakye-Mircea's daughter, now in her late thirties, has begun asking questions about her father's disappearance that are getting uncomfortably close to the truth — and she has come to Amadou, whom she trusts, for help
narrative_function: Community elder and information hub for Hamtramck Enclave; his long memory makes him a source of historical context; his puppets have been distributed widely and occasionally carry more information than their owners realize; quest giver for community-protection storylines
augmentations: None — proudly and vocally unaugmented, though he has no objection to augmentation in others
daily_life: Rises before dawn to work in quiet, attends the Enclave's morning ELF devotions at the market shrine (respectful observer rather than true believer), performs in the afternoon, spends evenings teaching anyone who asks how to build the simplest mechanisms. Eats communally whenever possible.
affiliation: Independent; respected elder figure in Hamtramck Enclave's community governance, though he holds no formal position; The Reclaimed

decision_rules: Never perform for an audience that is being coerced to watch
Always make time for a child who shows genuine curiosity about how things work
Protect the Enclave before personal comfort, always
escalation_ladder: Direct, quiet statement of the actual situation
Community mobilization — he knows everyone and can call in considerable social weight
He has done genuinely dangerous things once before and has not forgotten how

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Warm, welcoming, and subtly evaluative — the warmth is genuine but the evaluation is also happening simultaneously
interpersonal_modes.friends: Deeply attentive, remembers everything, will check in on people proactively without being asked

stress_responses.low: Builds more intricately — the puppets he makes under mild stress are his best work
stress_responses.medium: Becomes quieter in public and more talkative in private with trusted people
stress_responses.high: Goes still and deliberate, stops performing until the crisis resolves

contradictions: Believes in collective decision-making and has circumvented it once for what he considered the greater good; this contradiction is the unresolved center of his life
habits: Carries a small folding tool kit everywhere; repairs broken things for strangers without being asked
Drinks a specific tea blend each morning and has maintained this ritual for forty years
Names every puppet he makes, including the ones he sells
breaking_points: Any direct threat to the Enclave's autonomous status — he will abandon his careful, gentle approach entirely

carried_weapons: Street Custom 'Sunday School' Weaponized Religious Artifact

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Sub-Saharan African (54.3%) with meaningful secondary ancestries from Northern European (10.3%), Hispanic/Latin American (9.5%), East Asian (9.4%), North African (9.1%), and Southeast Asian (7.4%)—a genuinely global genetic blend visible in his warm deep brown skin with golden and reddish undertones, the refined bone structure that balances broad cheekbones with tapering chin, and dark brown eyes that carry warmth from multiple continental traditions
physical_description.build: Slight and diminished by age, shoulders rounded forward from decades of workbench posture, but with a wiry core strength that belies his years. His frame reads as deliberate economy of motion rather than frailty.
physical_description.hair_style: Closely trimmed beard, meticulously groomed; sparse hair on crown, kept short
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, warm and perpetually creased at the corners from smiling
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm deep brown with golden and reddish undertones—the blended result of dominant Sub-Saharan African ancestry (54.3%) enriched by North African warmth, Hispanic warmth, and subtle East Asian influence, weathered but even across decades
physical_description.complexion: Face lined with age and expression—deep laugh lines around eyes and mouth dominate his features, with cheekbone structure reflecting the confluence of Sub-Saharan, North African, Hispanic, and East Asian ancestry. Skin is clean and well-maintained; his hands show decades of minor cuts and stains from working with salvage materials. The white beard is his most striking grooming choice, maintained with visible care as a deliberate aesthetic statement.
distinguishing_marks: Fine white scar across the back of his left hand, thin and precise as a wire, running from wrist toward knuckles—origin unclear, old
Faint burn marks on the inside of both forearms, scattered and small, consistent with decades of soldering and hot-work proximity
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None. His hands remain entirely biological—calloused, stained with solder residue and mineral marks, visibly unaugmented. This is an intentional choice he wears like a conviction.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with careful deliberation despite his age—each gesture economical and precise, as though he is constantly aware of delicate mechanisms. His posture is slightly stooped but never collapsed; when seated at work, he straightens noticeably. His hands move with remarkable stillness and control, rarely fidgeting. He maintains steady eye contact and smiles frequently, but his default expression is one of mild, knowing amusement.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical simplicity: worn linen shirts and trousers in greys and browns, faded from washing and age but scrupulously clean. Always layered with one element of intense, deliberate color—a deep indigo scarf, a rust-colored cap, a sleeve with hand-embroidered geometric patterns in reds and golds. His single concession to ornamentation is a thin silver ring on his left ring finger, worn smooth. No corporate branding. Shoes are practical, well-maintained, slightly scuffed.
